title: 舊唐書 卷一九九上 東夷 日本國
edition: Wikisource digital transcription (unproofread); locators re-checked against it on 2026-09-24
author: 劉昫 et al.

license.notes: Text public domain. The chapter uses the Tang-court notice of the 天寶十二年 embassy and the outline of 朝衡's career; it does not use the compilation's later, legendary material.

notes: Tang-court-centred history compiled in 945. It reports the embassy from the Tang side, at year granularity, and describes 朝臣仲滿 (阿倍仲麻呂) under his adopted name 朝衡.
